SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

5. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.
   C. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.

   D. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

8. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   C. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.

9. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.

   C. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.

   C. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

13. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   C. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.

15. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.

16. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   C. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS

17. In three clear sentences, explain Earth and the Solar System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
